decisions_made: Release list for the CSG lives in GOVERNANCE KV key a2a-releases (operator-written, no tool can write it) until OTOI has a release grammar; no releases = deny all cross-agent delivery.
Source sets = sender + origins observed delivered to the sender within 24 hours (conservative over-taint); content returning to its origin card is private and needs no release.
Consent page shows only the platform part of the agent ID; the ID is reserved after Access sign-in, globally unique in the hub.
Issuance record lists agentId as verified and observedClient as observed (header-derived), and the governance extension states agentRuntimeGoverned: false, to avoid overclaiming (ADR-001 §3.1).
Discovery (list/get) requires the caller's own card to be registered; issued cards and agent IDs persist (24-hour rule applies to registrations and mailboxes).
Direct governance notification is recorded as unsupported on the Worker; denials go to hub counters and an operator log line only.
